view.name: Workspace Tasks
description: Manage and run tasks in your workspace
config.workspaceTasks.debug: Enable debug logging for Workspace Tasks
config.workspaceTasks.task.actionBar: Select which items should be shown in the task action bar for each task. This allows you to customize the actions available for tasks in the workspace.
config.workspaceTasks.autoRefresh: Automatically refresh tasks when changes are detected
config.workspaceTasks.autoRefresh.descri: Automatically refresh tasks when changes are detected
config.workspaceTasks.autoRefresh.markdo: When enabled, the extension will automatically refresh the task list whenever changes are detected in the workspace.
config.workspaceTasks.enabledTaskTypes.d: Select the types of tasks that the extension should support and display in the task list.
config.workspaceTasks.enabledTaskTypes.m: Choose the task types (e.g., npm, script, makefile) that the extension will recognize and show in the task list.
config.workspaceTasks.shellEnabledTaskTy: Enable support for specific shell script types. This allows the extension to recognize and run tasks defined in these shell scripts.
config.workspaceTasks.task.stopGracefulD: The delay in **milliseconds** before forcefully stopping (SIGKILL) a task after requesting it to stop gracefully (SIGINT).
config.workspaceTasks.task.stopCompoundD: When enabled, stopping a compound Visual Studio Code task from the Workspace Tasks stop action will also stop any currently running dependency tasks referenced by `dependsOn`.
config.workspaceTasks.task.iconType: Choose the Icon Type for Tasks
config.workspaceTasks.task.iconType.mark: Select the type of icon to display for tasks. Options include predefined icons or custom icons specified by the user.
config.workspaceTasks.task.iconTypeCusto: Specify a custom icon for the task. This can be a path to an png or svg file, or it can be a [ThemeIcon](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/icons-in-labels) in the format `$(iconName)`. `workspaceTasks.task.iconType` must be set to `custom` for this to take effect.
config.workspaceTasks.task.presentationO: Controls if the task panel is used for this task only (dedicated), shared between tasks (shared) or if a new panel is created on every task execution (new).
Controls whether the task output is revealed in the user interface.
Controls whether the panel showing the task output is taking focus.
Controls whether the command associated with the task is echoed in the user interface.
Controls whether the terminal is closed after executing the task.
Controls whether the terminal is cleared before executing the task.
config.workspaceTasks.task.singleClickAc: Action to perform when a task is single-clicked.  `run` - Run the task  `open` - Open the task  `none` - Do nothing
config.workspaceTasks.task.doubleClickAc: Action to perform when a task is double-clicked.  `run` - Run the task  `open` - Open the task  `none` - Do nothing
config.workspaceTasks.task.statusResetDe: The delay in **milliseconds** before resetting the task icon back to its original state after execution. Set to `0` to reset immediately.
config.workspaceTasks.shellAdditionalExt: Additional File Extensions for Shell Tasks

Add extra file extensions (beyond the default ones) that should be treated as shell tasks. Use a key-value format where the key is a file extension without the leading dot (e.g., `myscript`) and the value is the path to the shell interpreter (e.g., `/usr/local/bin/myshell`). This allows you to run custom script files as tasks within the extension.
config.workspaceTasks.shellPaths.markdow: Specify custom paths for shell interpreters. Use a key-value format where the key is the shell type (e.g., `bash`, `pwsh`) and the value is the path to the shell executable (e.g., `/usr/local/bin/bash`). This allows you to customize which shell interpreters are used for running shell tasks.
config.workspaceTasks.groups.useParentFo: Group tasks by their parent folder.
When enabled, tasks will be grouped based on their parent folder in addition to other grouping rules.
config.workspaceTasks.groups.taskSeparat: Separator used to split task name into groups.
Separator used to split task name into groups. For example, a task named `build:frontend` with a separator of `:` would be grouped under `build`. An empty string means no grouping will be applied.
config.workspaceTasks.exclude.descriptio: Glob patterns to exclude from tasks.
config.workspaceTasks.exclude.markdown: Glob patterns to exclude from tasks. For example, to ignore all tasks in `sample` folders, add `**/sample/**`. Note that the patterns follow the [glob syntax](https://github.com/micromatch/glob). `**/node_modules/**` and `**/.git/**` are always ignored
config.workspaceTasks.groups.enabled.des: Group tasks by type, folder, and custom separator.
config.workspaceTasks.groups.enabled.mar: When enabled, tasks will be grouped based on the specified separator and other grouping rules.
config.workspaceTasks.groups.recentTasks: When enabled, recent tasks will be grouped based on the specified separator and other grouping rules.
config.workspaceTasks.groups.compoundTas: When enabled, compound tasks (previously called 'Queues') will be grouped together in the task view. Otherwise, each compound task will be shown at the root level of the task view.
config.workspaceTasks.groups.expanded.ma: Control which groups are expanded by default. You can specify favorites, compound tasks, and recent tasks.
config.workspaceTasks.recentTasks.maxIte: Maximum number of recent tasks to display.
Maximum number of recent tasks to display in the Recent Tasks group. Once the limit is reached, the oldest tasks will drop off the list. Set to 0 to disable the Recent Tasks group.
config.workspaceTasks.compoundTasks.defa: Specify the default execution type for compound tasks (previously called 'Queues'). Options are 'sequential' or 'parallel'.
config.workspaceTasks.compoundTasks.incl: Include Visual Studio Code Compound Tasks

When enabled along with `workspaceTasks.groups.compoundTasks.enabled`, compound tasks defined in Visual Studio Code (using `type: 'compound'` in `tasks.json`) will be included in the `Compound Tasks` group. They will still be defined in the normal tree structure based on their `group` and `label` even if this setting is disabled.
config.workspaceTasks.taskDiscovery.fetc: Specify the fetch depth when discovering tasks from within the workspace. A value of `null` means full fetch, while a positive integer limits the depth of the fetch operation. This can help improve performance when working with large repositories.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.ac: Act allows you to run GitHub Actions locally. Specify the path to the [Act](https://github.com/nektos/act) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `act`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
workspaceTasks.act.envFile: Path to Act environment variables file
workspaceTasks.act.envFile.markdown: Specify the path to a .env file containing environment variables for Act. This file will be used to provide environment variable values when running GitHub Actions locally with Act. For examples of the file format see the [Act documentation](https://nektosact.com/usage/index.html#envsecrets-files-structure)
workspaceTasks.act.secretsFile.markdown: Specify the path to a .env file containing secrets for Act. This file will be used to provide secret values when running GitHub Actions locally with Act. For examples of the file format see the [Act documentation](https://nektosact.com/usage/index.html#envsecrets-files-structure).
workspaceTasks.act.variables.markdown: Variables to pass to 'act'. Each key-value pair represents a variable name and its corresponding value.
workspaceTasks.act.variablesFile.markdow: Path to the variables file for `act`. The file format is the same as `.env` file format.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.an: Specify the path to the Ant executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `ant`, `.bat` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.ant.ansicon.enable: When enabled, ANSICON will be used for Ant tasks to provide colored output in the terminal.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.an: Specify the path to the ANSICON executable. This is used to enable colored output for Ant tasks in the terminal. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.ms: Specify the path to the MSBuild executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `msbuild`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.co: Specify the path to the [Composer](https://getcomposer.org/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `composer`, `.bat` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.gr: Specify the path to the [Gradle](https://gradle.org/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `gradle`, `.bat` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.ju: Specify the path to the [Just](https://just.systems/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `just`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.pi: Specify the path to the [Pipenv](https://pipenv.pypa.io/en/latest/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `pipenv`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.po: Path to Poe the Poet executable

Specify the path to the [Poe the Poet](https://poethepoet.natn.io/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `poe`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.

Specify the path to the [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `poetry`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.ma: Specify the path to the Make executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `make`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.ra: Specify the path to the [Rake](https://ruby.github.io/rake/) executable. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.ma: Specify the path to the [Maven](https://maven.apache.org/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `mvn`, `.cmd` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.de: Specify the path to the [Deno](https://deno.land/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `deno`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.ca: Specify the path to the [Cargo](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `cargo`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.

Specify the path to the [cargo-make](https://sagiegurari.github.io/cargo-make/) executable. cargo-make is a Rust task runner and build tool using TOML-based Makefile.toml files. On Windows, if the path ends with `cargo-make`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, '~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory.
config.workspaceTasks.applicationPath.cm: Specify the path to the [CMake](https://cmake.org/) executable. On Windows, if the path ends with `cmake`, `.exe` will be appended automatically. On all platforms, `~/` will be expanded to the user's home directory. Note that if cmake is already in your PATH, you can leave this the default value.
config.workspaceTasks.cmake.buildDirecto: Relative path from the `CMakeLists.txt` directory to the CMake binary (build) directory. Absolute paths are also accepted. Defaults to `build`.
config.workspaceTasks.cmake.buildType.ma: The CMake build type passed as `-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE` during configuration and `--config` during the build step. One of `Debug`, `Release`, `RelWithDebInfo`, or `MinSizeRel`.
config.workspaceTasks.cmake.buildType.de: Debug build with no optimization and full debug information.
config.workspaceTasks.cmake.buildType.re: Fully optimized release build with no debug information.
Optimized build that also includes debug information.
config.workspaceTasks.cmake.generator.ma: CMake generator to use when configuring the project (e.g. `Ninja`, `Unix Makefiles`, `Visual Studio 17 2022`). Leave empty to use the platform default.
